hypothesis.statement: A fused ranking over verified BRR ancestry, commit lineage, regression verdicts, and context-graph relationships discovers relevant cross-repository branches and commits more accurately than lexical-only, BRR/commit-only, or context-graph-only retrieval.
hypothesis.primary_threshold: Fused macro F1@5 exceeds the best single-source arm by at least 0.05 absolute, with a paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval whose lower bound is greater than 0.
guardrails: Verified target precision@5 does not regress against the best single-source arm.
Candidate graph edges are reported separately and never count as verified hits.
Incomplete source coverage blocks a promotion verdict.
Untestable and no-benchmark regression states remain explicit and never count as green.

subject.system: Cross-repository branch and commit relevance discovery
source_contracts: QUE #5640 BRR + commits + regression + comment/context graph join
canonical context-relationship graph and cross-plane graph
subject.gold_set: human-adjudicated target IDs per frozen discovery query

design.unit_of_observation: one frozen query evaluated under one retrieval arm
design.assignment: Every query is evaluated by every arm; arm execution order is deterministically shuffled within query using the preregistered seed.

arms.description: Lexical-only baseline over repository, branch, commit-subject, PR/issue title metadata.
BRR ancestry/disposition and commit-lineage signals; no context-graph expansion.
Verified context/comment graph edges only; candidate edges are listed separately.
Equal-weight combination of lexical, branch/commit, verified graph, and regression signals.

ranking.lexical: query-token overlap divided by the number of unique query tokens
ranking.branch_commit: 0.6 * normalized BRR signal + 0.4 * normalized commit signal

design.candidate_handling: Only evidence_status=verified participates in ranking and gold-hit metrics. Evidence_status=candidate is emitted as a separate candidate list with its source references.

outcomes.primary: macro F1@5 against the adjudicated verified gold target set

decision_rule.text: The fused arm is a champion candidate only after at least 30 adjudicated queries across at least 3 repositories and 3 task families, complete source coverage, a paired 95% bootstrap interval for F1@5 improvement over the best single-source arm with lower bound > 0, absolute improvement >= 0.05, and no verified precision@5 regression. The strategy remains observational until independent review and the existing proposal/dual-gate lifecycle authorize adoption.

automation.trigger_owner: existing vm-brr-delta / BRR v2 export cycle and the existing #5552/#5640 joined evidence path
automation.execution: offline replay over immutable exported source snapshots; one EXPERIMENT record per query x arm
automation.reason: The private VM-published BRR v2 registry and joined records are not available in this session. Campaign remains design-only until existing source exports and their exact SHA/coverage receipts are available.

required_sources: BRR v2 registry export with repository identity, branch tip SHA, disposition, ahead/behind counts, and coverage receipt
commit export bound to the same repository and branch tip SHA
regression feature-progress map with green/regressed/untestable/no-benchmark verdicts
context/comment graph with verified/candidate edge status and evidence URLs
frozen query set with adjudicated gold target IDs
source_requirements.sha_binding: Every source record binds to an immutable source SHA and collection timestamp; all joined rows retain repository-qualified identity.

constraints: BRR remains read-only and retains branch-reconciliation-registry/v1.
Reuse existing BRR, commit, regression, graph, QUE, QDesk, and DoE infrastructure.
No second scheduler, queue, collector, graph store, dashboard, or promotion engine.
No branch mutation, merge, close, retarget, push, delete, or archive action.
Missing, private, stale, partial, or untestable evidence remains explicit.
No raw discussion bodies, secrets, credentials, browser state, or session data.

registration.note: Design committed before evaluator execution. No live BRR run or champion is claimed.
